term.name: compatibility_warning
term.definition: A report of a Schematron compile report sink with the code schematron:compatibility: a known deviation of real rule sets from ISO/IEC 19757-3:2025 that sxml reads as its authors mean it (a parameter named twice in one pattern instance, a pattern variable read outside its pattern, a rule's let after its assertions), with the clause it deviates from; no error, never in the error record ()
